name: Permanent Residence Permit After 5 Years of Temporary Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Must have resided in Czechia continuously for at least 5 years as of the application date.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 5 years of continuous legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: A Czech language exam certificate is mandatory, though statutory exemptions exist.
requirements.fix_path: Pass the required Czech language exam, or qualify for an exemption.

requirements.blocker_text: Must prove sufficient funds for residence (specific minimum amount not published in the source reviewed).

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years of continuous residence
Criminal-record-equivalent document and tax-disclosure consent (on request)
Application fee CZK2,500 (CZK1,000 for minors under 15)

outcome.duration_length: indefinite status; residence document issued for 10 years (5 years for foreign nationals under 15)

sources.title: ipc.gov.cz -- Permanent Residence Permit After 5 Years of Temporary Residence: continuous-residence requirement, Czech language exam, funds and criminal-record checks, 10-year document, unrestricted labour-market and social-welfare access

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Czechia's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. Holders gain unrestricted labour-market access, public health insurance eligibility, social welfare access, and potential pension entitlements per the source. citizenship_after_months set to 60 reflecting cz_naturalisation's own separate 5-year-as-permanent-resident requirement (i.e. this status must itself be held 5 years before citizenship eligibility, on top of whatever temporary-residence time preceded it -- see cz_naturalisation's notes on the two sequential 5-year clocks). Administrative fee: CZK2,500 (CZK1,000 for applicants under 15).
